gate: No remaining material source blocker. Combined independent numerical qualification, final stack accounting, frozen identities and the parent canonical-run gate are still required.
interpretation_limits: Polynomial translation preserves represented older evidence; it cannot renew discarded nonlinear historical derivatives.
Raw-block reevaluation is nonlinear conditional on an approximate carried boundary after transport; state transport is not archived replay.
A metric stop can still commit observations at the unchanged estimate; it is explicitly unresolved and is not a successful proposal or precision claim.

The current estimate can become infeasible under a new raw block before proposal generation. The engine stops instead of attempting a separate feasibility-restoration solve; this does not establish exclusion of every supported parameter point.

Post-re_process result costs come from the commit preflight without the prior; only stop reason/round/fraction are restored. A host needing Armijo details must capture refinement output before commit and respect cost/prior availability flags.

Accumulated approximation error, scalar input quantization, finite unmodeled temperature and parameter support remain part of the declared model limitations. No credible interval, coverage, global optimum or M23 readiness follows.

scope: Independent algebra/source/phase-liveness review of parent-owned engine. Rolling model kernels were authored by this reviewer and receive separate independent review by interval_audit.

verified.finding: Source and immutable calibration/model generation identify the input; offered/retained/committed cursors obey next_index+block_count+ingress_count=next_ingress_sequence. Invalid/full offers do not mutate context; admission transfers raw ownership without adding evidence.

Quadratic-first triangular factor contributes every represented residual row, including constant residual energy. Original-coordinate full joint gradient and packed GN include all sparse-feature cross effects; the current raw block is evaluated separately from the same boundary for each query.

Cost and gradient use the original equal-weight whole-mixture prior exactly once per requested objective; its fixed kernel precision is added only as optimization geometry. Original support-normalizer constants are omitted only from within-prefix costs/contrasts. No posterior or prior is merged into observation rows.
Charge extrema include zero and all retained intervals in sequential I*dt/3600 order. SOC support uses charge/exp(logQ), matching original division order. All public support bounds are unchanged.

Cost-only queries leave packed136 and gradient16 unchanged. Their point remains live; query state224 and decoded reading32 occupy only the final256B. The older-factor temporary Jrow uses the first128B of that phase before rm_query_init initializes the full state.

The explicit128B auxiliary union contains an88B refinement configuration/baseline view and is mutually exclusive with checkpoint coding. It avoids an extra persistent allocation and removes the former proposal helper/input stack frame. Embedded pointers are temporary views, not checkpoint serialization.

The support primitive receives original-coordinate gradient/metric and a bank-owned immutable anchor. Its reciprocal-coordinate parameterization never changes the prior density measure. Original-chart slope is saved before the result phase changes.

The exact returned full endpoint is copied into the first16 packed doubles after the metric dies. Cost-only trials preserve this storage. Full alpha1 uses those exact values; later trials use anchor+alpha*(endpoint-anchor). Every trial rechecks original support and conditional physical state.

Accepted estimates require finite total-objective decrease beyond the computed cost allowance and quarter-slope Armijo requirement. The combination guard uses32 operations. These are computed-operand arithmetic guards, not nonlinear approximation certificates or voltage-error thresholds.

Finite direction, reciprocal-rounding, metric and no-trial stops are distinguishable. Nonpositive metric causes no proposed step or repair and remains an explicit CH_STOP_METRIC unresolved outcome. Nonfinite/other negative query failures propagate. No finite stop is declared nonlinear stationarity.

Model-work counter prevalidation reserves2*block_count for physical/block preflight plus merge. Physical preflight and boundary transport precede factor mutation; normalized raw-log-chart translation is kept separate from boundary-jet raw-coordinate transport.

Old factor is translated once, boundary state is transported approximately, each retained row is appended once, and committed cursor/QR-row count advance only after complete merge. Raw slots retire only then. Unexpected failures after mutation latch unavailable; no partial factor remains queryable.

CH_OK denotes completed ingestion, not optimizer convergence. Refinement stop reason/round/fraction survive commit; committed prior remains the original prior and the estimate remains in the original entering chart.
